description: A mature human microRNA is computationally predicted to target (repress) a gene. Transcript-level miRDB predictions are represented once per microRNA–gene pair, with the maximum prediction score across the gene's predicted target transcripts.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Date and time the relationship was last created or changed.

source_contributions.scope: Human microRNA predictions from miRDB v6.0, with no score threshold. Only predictions whose target transcripts map to genes present in SPOKE are represented. Protein-coding and microRNA genes are eligible targets, including genes marked obsolete. Retired genes retain their mapped predictions rather than transferring them to successor genes.
source_contributions.description: Predictions originate at the microRNA–transcript level and are summarized at the gene level. Transcript identifiers and individual transcript scores are not stored.

properties.name: prediction_score
properties.description: Maximum miRDB prediction score across the gene's transcripts predicted as targets of this microRNA; scores range from 50 to 100.
properties.notes: prediction_score is stored at the precision given in the source, without rounding.
